g3-implement.title: G3 drying-window guard (the monotone-grip protection): implement
g3-implement.imperative:
Fill the implementer handoff and dispatch. This is the LARGEST piece of new logic in the plan and is deliberately its own gate.

WHY IT EXISTS: acceptance says 'keep it conservative enough that genuinely wet running is still excluded (the monotone-grip assumption still needs dry)', and a severity threshold ALONE cannot deliver that. The fit never ingests a wet lap -- _read_clean_session_laps hard-filters to SOFT/MEDIUM/HARD at :215. The real hazard is that a recovered `mixed` session's SURVIVING DRY laps sit on a DRYING track, whose falling lap times are DRYING, not rubber accumulation -- a direct violation of the monotone rubber-in model _saturating() (:287-289) encodes. Without this guard, g2 recovers coverage by admitting exactly the sessions most likely to produce a spuriously large curve.

TASK: for a `mixed` session, restrict the fit to laps AFTER the session's last wet-compound lap (by lap_number), record where that window starts, and if the window carries fewer than MIN_STINTS_FOR_FIT (:103) usable stints, fall to the EXISTING thin_fallback path (:503-508) rather than fitting. A `dry` session is unaffected; a `wet` session is not fit at all.

SCOPE: src/physics/layer2/grip_baseline.py, tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_grip_baseline.py. EXCLUDED: the severity classification itself (g2, frozen by now), the sigma inflation (g4), the curve's functional form (#678).
